listing.name: Enhanced Sprites v. 0.08 + Hull Livery
listing.summary: Adds 121 new sprites and 15 hull livery hullmods to recolor ships and differentiate variants.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 121 new sprites and 15 hull livery hullmods to recolor ships and differentiate variants.

description: Adds 121 new sprites that can be used to recolor Odyssey, Paragon, Onslaught, Conquest, Dominator, Medusa, Eagle, and Radiant using 15 hull livery hullmods. It also makes enemy ships use these sprites so that variants of ships look different. The sprites are generated using AI tools and hand-finished to add lighting or polish.
